item.description:
INRIA/spoon
Spoon is a metaprogramming library to analyze and transform Java source code. 🥄 is made with ❤️, 🍻 and ✨. It parses source files to build a well-designed AST with powerful analysis and transformation API.
Java repository by INRIA, created in 2013, with 1,964 stars and 394 forks. Starred on 2019-10-07.
Homepage: http://spoon.gforge.inria.fr/
https://github.com/INRIA/spoon

Source: starred on GitHub on 2019-10-07: INRIA/spoon.
